technique_name: Name 4 features of a scientific research paper.
description: A scientific research paper typically contains the following features: an introduction, a literature and methodology review, data analysis, results and discussion, a conclusion, and references. The introduction provides background information to the reader. The literature and methodology review reviews related studies and outlines the methods used in the research.
